tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Full history of one number as CSV: FX since 1999 (fx.EUR.USD), World Bank since 1960 (wb.{code}.{country}), ECB yields (ecb.yield10y.IT), Eurostat, power prices (smard.price.day), sunspots (noaa.sunspot-number). Example: {"id":"wb.FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.DE","from":"2000"}; {"q":"inflation germany"} finds id

tools.name: find_data
tools.description: Lists up to 10 series that may answer a data question, each with its call_api arguments; pick the one whose measure, place and time fit, else this service does not have it. Example: {"query":"inflation chile"}.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Newest value of one World Bank indicator for every member of a country group, highest first. period "common" puts every row on one period (members without it in missing). top (1-50) ranks the members and returns the first N, each row with its rank (order desc or asc). Example: {"indicator":"SP.POP.T

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays of a country, or one of its regions, in one year. Example: {"country":"DE","year":2027,"region":"BY"}.

tools.name: ask_anything
tools.description: Answers a data question in words. Example: {"query":"population of pakistan"}.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Searches the endpoint catalog. Example: {"search":"electricity price germany"}.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Runs one endpoint by id. Example: {"apiId":"fx-currency-convert","params":{"from":"USD","to":"EUR","amount":"250"}}.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Values recorded from a live endpoint over time. Example: {"apiId":"bundle-location-brief","params":{"place":"Berlin"}}.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Stores a report of a wrong value for a manual check; changes no data. Example: {"series":"fx.EUR.USD","kind":"wrong_value"}.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_anything" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Routes a plain-language data question to the best matching live endpoint, runs it and returns the data as compact JSON with source, license and data_freshness. Use first when you do not know which endpoint fits, e.g. "convert 250 usd to eur", "weather berlin tomorrow", "germany inflation", "bitcoin " → after: "Answers a data question in words. Example: {"query":"population of pakistan"}."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
